title: fix(app-shell): draw the environment list's locked mark only for a viewer who can upgrade (objectui#12983)
body:
Fixes #12983

## What changes

On a Free organization's environment list, the locked mark "Development environments · Team plan and up" (zh 「开发环境 · 团队版起」) is now drawn only for a viewer the entitlement summary sends an `upgradeUrl` to. This executes ruling B on objectstack-ai/cloud#2917 (comment `6251325902`), item 2: the development upsell reaches only whoever can upgrade.

- **The mark's condition.** In `EnvironmentListToolbar`, the `upgrade_for_development` branch draws `DevelopmentLockedMark` only when the create action is on the bar AND `entitlements.upgradeUrl` is present.
- **The unlinked variant is retired.** `DevelopmentLockedMark` used to draw an unlinked `span` when no `upgradeUrl` came. That branch and its test are gone. The mark now has one shape, the link, and its `upgradeUrl` prop is required. The component was never exported; `git grep` for `DevelopmentLockedMark` and for the `environment-development-locked` test id finds only the toolbar file and its two test files, so nothing else imports it.

## Why `upgradeUrl` is the signal

The control plane already trims the summary by role. In cloud's `GET /cloud/environment-entitlements` handler, `resolveSummaryCanManage` decides, and `upgradeUrl` and `contactSalesUrl` are spread into the answer only when the viewer manages the organization (read at cloud `c403d600`). objectui keeps that answer verbatim (`useEnvironmentEntitlements`: `upgradeUrl: data.upgradeUrl`). So the server's own role decision reaches the toolbar as the presence of `upgradeUrl`. No viewer flag is added to the summary, and no cloud change is needed.

The `upgrade_for_development` state is reachable only from the summary: `decideEnvironmentCta` returns it only when `canCreateDevelopmentEnv === false`, which only `development.canCreate` sets. So in this branch an absent `upgradeUrl` always means the server sent none.

## Unchanged

- The toolbar's other actions render the same for a manager and a member (asserted on the rendered bar's markup).
- On a paid plan, a plain member's create action ("Add development environment", zh 「新建开发环境」) renders exactly as a manager's. The same holds for "Set up your production environment" and for the capacity-unknown state.
- `hasCreateAction`, the capability gate, the loading skeleton, and the `?runAction=create_environment` arming. In the plan-locked state the deep link is still consumed and opens nothing, for a member too (new test).

## Also edited, because this change made them false

- `useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts`: a comment said that an absent `upgradeUrl` makes the mark draw unlinked. It now says the mark is not drawn.
- `.changeset/12190-env-list-locked-mark.md` is still pending (no release has consumed it). Its bullet "When the summary carries no `upgradeUrl`, the mark is drawn unlinked" now says no mark is drawn. Its package declarations are unchanged (app-shell patch, i18n minor); `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the modification, report-only.
- A new changeset, `.changeset/12983-env-locked-mark-managers.md`, declares `@object-ui/app-shell` patch. No locale key is added or removed.

## Tests

All runs through `/home/user/objectstack/scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, verdicts read from its VERDICT line.

- **Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite at `a441e252`**, in 8 shards (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard=K/8 packages/app-shell/`), each VERDICT command-exit 0. Test Files: 1578 passed and 1 skipped, 1579 in all, equal to the 1579 tracked `*.test.ts` / `*.test.tsx` files under `packages/app-shell`. Tests: 14834 passed and 9 skipped (14843). The skipped file is one of the suite's pre-existing conditional skips; the new tests skip nothing.
- **The environment directory at `d461e38c`** (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/environment/`): Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 89 passed (89).

What changed in `EnvironmentListToolbar.test.tsx`:

- Removed: `no upgradeUrl → the mark is drawn unlinked; no URL is composed (objectui#10437)`, the unlinked variant's test.
- Added, `the locked mark reaches only a viewer who can upgrade (objectui#12983)`, where a member's summary is the manager's with `plan`, `upgradeUrl` and `contactSalesUrl` removed (the role trim's shape):
  - free plan: the manager's mark is a link to `upgradeUrl`; the member gets no mark, no bar and no text;
  - free plan, member: no link, no button, no metadata label;
  - free plan: the other actions' rendered bar is byte-identical for both viewers;
  - paid plan, capacity unknown, and no production environment yet (`it.each`): the member's rendered bar, create action included, is byte-identical to the manager's;
  - zh, paid plan: the member still gets 「新建开发环境」.
- Added in the deep-link block: in the plan-locked state, a member's `?runAction=create_environment` is consumed as before, nothing opens and nothing is drawn.

## Ablation

One ablation, at `d461e38c`, through `/home/user/objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. It dropped the `upgradeUrl` condition in `EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`: anchor `hasCreateAction && upgradeUrl ?` replaced with `hasCreateAction ?` (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `5e8a50d2` to `b29794ae`).

- Ran both toolbar test files: **4 failed, 27 passed (31)**. The four are the member cases (manager/member, member no-link, other actions, member deep link). Each failed on the mark being drawn as a link with `href` "undefined", e.g. `expected { tag: 'A', href: 'undefined', … } to be null`.
- The paid-plan and manager cases stayed green, as they should: they never depend on that condition.
- Restore: blob after restore `5e8a50d2` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- No `dist` is involved: both suites import the toolbar by relative path. The later commit `a441e252` only changes a TypeScript annotation in the test helper.

## Gates

Local, exit codes captured before any pipe.

- **Type-check at `a441e252`**: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0. It ran after building the dependency closure (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, exit 0). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists 1579 app-shell test files, the changed one among them.
- **Lint**: `pnpm run lint` in `packages/app-shell` at `d461e38c` exited 0 (0 errors, 4017 warnings package-wide). One of those warnings was on an added line, an `any` in the new test helper, and `a441e252` removed it. `eslint` on the three changed source and test files at `a441e252` exited 0 with 17 warnings, none on an added line (diff-mapped).
- **Lock-free scripts at `a441e252`, each exit 0**: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:action-ref-convention`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`.
- **Changeset scripts, each exit 0**: `check-changeset-presence` (3 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset added), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only; it names the 12190 edit), `check-type-check-coverage` and `check-lint-coverage`.
- objectui has no gate-derivation script, so this list was derived by hand from `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`. The repo-wide farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud comment beside the summary's role trim (the one saying that, absent `upgradeUrl`, the console draws an unlinked locked mark) goes stale when this lands. The card names its carrier: objectstack-ai/cloud#2917, the next cloud PR that touches that file.
- No screenshot or stack is attached, per the dispatch. The seat reads the mark at the next objectui pin in cloud.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
